binary_checks.method: Selected member references/access/arithmetic inspected with JDK javap; no game method execution. Not formal equivalence of the complete shipped source and binary.

checks.conclusion: Public registration appends an ACTION to the after-update collection, dispatched after resource update loops. UI-paused nonzero-speed behavior needs runtime validation; no standalone menu/unload contract is established.
Scene logistics and incoming station goods are added; player trade promises are subtracted. Not warehouse-only inventory.
Private/package API requests CORE state replacement with Menu.make; no SCRIPT unload callback is established by this path.
Abstract disposal method is package-private, not a callback a normal mod subclass can implement.
